metadata.case_name: NGAI SAU SEN v. SOABAR SYSTEMS HONG KONG B.V. T/A AVERY DENNISON HONG KONG B.V.

source: This is a personal injury compensation claim of the plaintiff against the defendant, his former employer, for a sprained back injury.
There was no dispute that the plaintiff sustained low back injury on the morning of 6 April 2004.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: remaining discomfort suffered by the plaintiff on account of his low back pain

treatments_received: medical consultation at Princess Margaret Hospital (casualty department)
medical consultation at Tuen Mun Hospital
consultations with Dr. Choy Si Ho (Dr. Choy had granted sick leave to the plaintiff on 5 occasions)
massage treatment from a Chinese herbalist in Shenzhen
massage parlour overnight visits in Shenzhen

losses.description: loss of his earning capacity as the plaintiff had not been able to retain his warehouse attendant work on account of his injury; assessed his loss of earning capacity to be HK$10,000.
